create_text_dataset_reader: create a TextDatasetReader instance to load text files into a HuggingFace dataset with configurable split and features
read_text_dataset_streaming: read text files as a streaming dataset by passing streaming=True to TextDatasetReader and calling read
read_text_dataset_map_style: read text files as a map-style dataset by calling read on a TextDatasetReader with keep_in_memory enabled
review_text_dataset_reader_init: review the TextDatasetReader __init__ to understand how path_or_paths, split, features, cache_dir, and num_proc are configured
refactor_text_dataset_reader_read: refactor the TextDatasetReader read method to customize download_config, download_mode, or verification_mode parameters
